originalTitle: Satya Nadella says he’s AGI-pilled now
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says he's AGI-pilled, at least when it comes to how AI might make startling changes to the structure of the economy and how politics might change because of it. content: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says he’s AGI-pilled, at least when it comes to how AI might make startling changes to the structure of the economy and how politics might change because of it. “I am AGI-pilled in the sense that at an economy level, what is the political economy’s organization around AGI?” he asked at a roundtable discussion following his Microsoft Ignite keynote at the Chase Center in San Francisco. But Nadella doesn’t think frontier models like Claude are conscious. “I don’t think so,” he said, adding that he follows Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman’s view that companies should not give rights to models and treat them like they might have a moral status, which companies like Anthropic do as a matter of principle. Suleyman has told me he thinks Anthropic’s team has “wireheaded” themselves, and that this approach is dangerous. Nadella wasn’t quite as firm about it. “It’s a good debate,” he said. “I’m not sort of dogmatic about it. What I’m saying is the most important social technical issue we have to deal with is how do you ensure that an economy can diffuse this technology broadly?” I asked Nadella how he was thinking about AI after hearing his response to another reporter’s questions about Anthropic releasing more products in its office suite. Nadella talked at length about the potential collapse of the economy and the end of democracy if one AI model were allowed to achieve monopoly status. “Most people think about this as a competition between tech firms, which of course it will be,” he said. “But remember, the model has no limits. It’ll be a healthcare company. It can be a financial services company. It can be anything if it wants to be. It can take over the government. Thinking of this as some narrow competition between tech firms, of who is going to get to the next trillion dollars of market cap, is one of the strangest, narrowest ways to think about it.” Nadella went on to say that the very nature of companies stood to be disrupted in the future. “If intelligence has network effects, what is the future of a firm?” he asked. “If the model sees anything and learns it, and essentially all of human capital collapses into token capital, what is the role of a firm and the human capital in a firm? That’s the debate.” “I think the political economy is going to get more and more interesting in that context. No one — at least in a democracy — can even win an election if this just goes that way, if there’s only capital and there’s no labor. I mean, I don’t know, that’s not an economy.” “If the Marxist sort of view is that there’s only one firm, then it’s over, right? For all of us. Not just for me. You are also going to somehow be some affiliate of Anthropic.” Needless to say, this is not how tech CEOs usually talk about the launch of competing spreadsheet software. Of course, Nadella was also promoting Microsoft’s various AI tools at Ignite, which promise to let enterprise clients pick the most cost-effective models for various tasks, run their own models, and control their own data in different ways. The idea here is that the market will demand many different kinds of models and sovereign data in order to keep control from centralizing, a theme Nadella kept coming back to as we spoke. “I think that if you believe that the world, the economy needs more than one firm or two firms, then by definition there need to be as many models as firms of some sort,” he said.

chineseContent: 微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 表示，他对 AGI 很着迷，至少在人工智能可能如何对经济结构产生惊人的变化以及政治可能因此而发生变化时是这样。 “我是 AGI 的拥护者，在经济层面上，围绕 AGI 的政治经济学组织是什么？”他在旧金山大通中心的 Microsoft Ignite 主题演讲后的圆桌讨论中问道。但纳德拉并不认为像克劳德这样的前沿模型是有意识的。他说：“我不这么认为。”他补充说，他遵循微软人工智能首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼（Mustafa Suleyman）的观点，即公司不应赋予模型权利，并像对待他们可能具有道德地位一样对待他们，而像 Anthropic 这样的公司则将其视为原则问题。苏莱曼告诉我，他认为 Anthropic 的团队已经“头脑简单”了，这种做法很危险。纳德拉对此并没有那么坚定。 “这是一场很好的辩论，”他说。 “我对此并不教条。我想说的是，我们必须处理的最重要的社会技术问题是如何确保经济体能够广泛传播这项技术？”在听到纳德拉回答另一位记者关于 Anthropic 在其办公套件中发布更多产品的问题后，我问纳德拉他如何看待人工智能。纳德拉详细讨论了如果允许一种人工智能模型获得垄断地位，经济可能会崩溃，民主也会终结。 “大多数人认为这是科技公司之间的竞争，当然事实确实如此，”他说。 “但请记住，该模式没有限制。它将是一家医疗保健公司。它可以是一家金融服务公司。如果它愿意的话，它可以是任何东西。它可以接管政府。将其视为科技公司之间的狭隘竞争，谁将成为
